title: Prescriptions Store Rule: Waiting Allowance on Relabel Remakes
content:
Where a relabel remake of a Kestrel Prescriptions fill is made some days after the pharmacist reviewed the wrong-directions-label report, the relabel waiting allowance applies.

## Rule

The relabel waiting allowance counts the calendar days from the review date of the answered report, as day 0, to today:

| Days from the review date to today | Allowance days |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | 2 |
| 1 up to fewer than 7 | 1 |
| 0 (remake on the review date) | none |

Each allowance day adds the prescribed daily units — the prescription's written quantity divided by its written days supply — to the relabel remake quantity.

## Both sides (hypothetical review on day 0, 3 prescribed daily units)

- Remake on day 6: 1 day, 3 units added. Remake on day 7: 2 days, 6 units added.
- Remake on day 0: no days. Remake on day 1: 1 day, 3 units added.
